resolution: Diagnosed the [live-regions] log the user asked about: it comes from pushLiveMaterialRegions in cart/editor/world/livePush.ts:314, which runs at the tail of every pushLiveWorld. Every placement mutates the pieces array, WorldViewport/PlaytestSurface re-push the whole live world, and the region pusher re-scans all placed pieces and re-binds every liveMaterial slot, logging the summary unconditionally — hence the line on every click. The '2' in prop:primitive:cylinder:2 is the primitive model's mint sequence from allocatePrimitiveModelId (second stored cylinder primitive), not a chunk number; ':slot-0' is the texture slot index wearing the liveMaterial. No code changed — question answered.
